examples.explanation: Reordering "abcd" can produce "abcd"; the surplus letter is "e".
The first string is empty, so the only letter of "t" is the extra one.
Three 'a' letters pair up; one 'a' is left over.

hints: Adding up character codes of both strings leaves a difference equal to the extra letter.
XOR-ing all codes cancels paired letters and reveals the surplus one.
A 26-slot frequency table also works: the letter whose count differs is the answer.
title: 465. Find the Difference
